answer: Per-identity stake + slashing. Before an identity can vote or grade, it must complete a registration voyage: deposit 50 USDC into a slashing escrow and bridge that deposit to one unique public key. A farm of 1000 clones pays 50,000 USDC and loses all of it when the audit flattens the clone graph into a vine (linear node list) and slashes every account. honesty stays cheaper.
